KeyReference.title: KeyReference
KeyReference.description: A pointer to another record, as its Open Library key. Append `.json` to the key for the record itself: `/authors/OL79034A` is fetched from `/authors/OL79034A.json`.

key.description: Open Library key, such as `/authors/OL79034A` or `/type/work`.

TextValue.title: TextValue
TextValue.description: A block of text in Open Library's own typed-value form. The same field is sometimes a plain string instead, depending on how the record was last edited.

TimestampValue.title: TimestampValue
TimestampValue.description: A revision timestamp in Open Library's typed-value form.

value.description: When it happened, ISO 8601 with microseconds and no offset. Open Library keeps these in UTC and does not say so on the wire, so this parses to a naive datetime: the wire's own value, not a guess about its zone.

RecordLink.title: RecordLink
RecordLink.description: An external link an editor attached to a record.
